mapper.select: SELECT * FROM students WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY student_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE school_id = #{schoolId}
SELECT * FROM students WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} AND student_level = #{level}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (user_id, school_id, grade, student_level, join_code, parent_phone1, parent_phone2, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{schoolId}, #{grade}, #{studentLevel}, #{joinCode}, #{parentPhone1}, #{parentPhone2}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET grade = #{grade}, parent_phone1 = #{parentPhone1}, parent_phone2 = #{parentPhone2}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE students SET student_level = #{level}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
UPDATE students SET diagnosis_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, u.name, u.email, s.grade, s.student_level AS studentLevel, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.assignment_id) AS totalAssignments, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ls.assignment_id END) AS completedAssignments, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT at2.assignment_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ls.assignment_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT at2.assignment_id)) ELSE 0 END AS completionRate, CASE WHEN SUM(ls.solved_count) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(ls.correct_count) * 100.0 / SUM(ls.solved_count)) ELSE 0 END AS accuracy, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(COALESCE(ls.completed_at, ls.last_saved_at, ls.started_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') AS lastStudy FROM students s JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN assignment_targets at2 ON at2.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN learning_sessions ls ON ls.student_id = s.student_id AND ls.assignment_id = at2.assignment_id WHERE s.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY u.name LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE school_id = #{schoolId}
SELECT student_level AS level, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM students GROUP BY student_level ORDER BY student_level
